2317-5478-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2445-2511-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-2511-5254.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

4772-5254-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
4772-5254-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4247-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

2438-4640-7082--201.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Sokka and Suki triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-5631-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5631-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Skeleton Crew.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

851-3129-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3478-5412-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability
Repeat.

1987-2187-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2187-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

117-1636-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
117-1636-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Talrand triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

6797-7084-7705.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

240-719-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-5686.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

4559-5226-5272-6757.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5226-5272-6757.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Farid triggers, creating a Scrap token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Scrap and Munitions tokens.
The Munitions token triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Metalwork Colossus ability, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4968-6593-7267.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Michelangelo.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
4968-6593-7267.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar if desired.

1090-3817-6797.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

969-2366-3512-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
969-2366-3512-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-4211-4885.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3734-4375-5231.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4013-5004-5705-6643.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {3}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Cathodion. When it enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Cathodion and the Eldrazi Spawn, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3499-4053-5499--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3499-4053-5499--5.description:
Activate the creature with persist by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the persist creature.
Repeat.

3054-4050-6580.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-6580.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-1283-2020-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

856-997-4321-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-997-4321-6351.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

428-1692-1694-3769.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
428-1692-1694-3769.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

1365-1379-2981-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-2981-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4770-5542-5554.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure token.
You control at least one additional creature with mana value 2 or less that can be cast using colored mana.
4770-5542-5554.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers twice, creating two copies of a Treasure token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and another creature with mana value 2 or less that can be cast using colored mana from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 4 one additional time if you do not have enough mana to cast the other creature returned to your hand in step 3.
Cast the other creature returned to your hand in step 3 by paying its mana cost.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers twice, creating two copies of a Treasure token you control.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.
4770-5542-5554.notes: If the other creature has mana value 1 or less, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens, and you may either make Gnome tokens or copy other artifact tokens using Oltec Matterweaver's triggers.

914-3525-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Saheeli.
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
914-3525-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist with haste.
When the token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}{R}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.

1379-1543-2984-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel of the Hull Clade does not have summoning sickness.
Ugin has at least 12 loyalty counters on it.
1379-1543-2984-4312.description:
Activate Vorel of the Hull Clade by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Ugin.
Activate Ugin by removing twelve loyalty counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

643-2457-4434-4762.notablePrerequisites: Devoted Druid does not have a -1/-1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
643-2457-4434-4762.description:
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
When the Insect enters the battlefield as a Treefolk due to Maskwood Nexus, Quickbeam triggers, giving Devoted Druid and up to one other creature +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

1088-2034-2060-3602.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Persistent Specimen, adding {C}{C}.
When Persistent Specimen dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and goading it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Persistent Specimen by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

444-890-1029-5162.notablePrerequisites: Kwain and Palladium Myr do not have summoning sickness.
444-890-1029-5162.description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Kwain by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life, and allowing your opponent to draw a card and gain 1 life.
Tolarian Kraken and Drogskol Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Drogskol Reaver trigger, causing you to draw a card, triggering Tolarian Kraken.
Resolve both Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Palladium Myr and Kwain.
Repeat.

38-1298-3368-4280.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting the spell.
Veyran and Ovika each trigger twice.
Resolve both Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve both Ovika triggers, creating six 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature tokens with haste.
Resolve Reiterate, creating a copy of the spell it was targeting and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Veyran triggers twice, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Skirk Prospector six times by sacrificing the six Phyrexian Goblins, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

565-966-4503-5195.description:
Cast Sea Gate Stormcaller by paying {1}{U}.
Sea Gate Stormcaller enters the battlefield, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value two or less.
Cast Unsubstantiate by paying {1}{U}, targeting Sea Gate Stormcaller.
Sea Gate Stormcaller, Orvar, and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Sea Gate Stormcaller trigger, copying Unsubstantiate, targeting the original Unsubstantiate.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Unsubstantiate, returning the original Unsubstantiate to your hand.
Resolve the Orvar trigger, creating a token copy of Sea Gate Stormcaller.
The Sea Gate Stormcaller token enters the battlefield, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast with mana value two or less.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger from step 4, creating a Treasure token.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.

2757-3340-3459.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
The Treasure enters the battlefield, triggering Battered Golem, untapping Battered Golem.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Battered Golem, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

711-1037-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Multani's Harmony attached to Fallowsage.
Fallowsage does not have summoning sickness.
711-1037-4222.description:
Activate Fallowsage for {U}.
Fallowsage triggers, drawing a card.
Activate Freed from the Real to untap Fallowsage.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

292-2265-3693.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Walking Ballista.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-2265-3693.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.
